title: Audio Analysis Schema
description: A schema for representing detailed audio analysis data from a music track.

meta.description: Metadata about the analysis process itself.

analyzer_version.description: Version of the audio analysis software.

platform.description: The operating system platform where the analysis was run.

detailed_status.description: A human-readable status of the analysis.

status_code.description: A status code for the analysis (0 typically indicates success).

timestamp.description: The UNIX timestamp of when the analysis was performed.

analysis_time.description: The duration of the analysis in seconds.

input_process.description: Details about the input audio processing.

track.description: High-level audio features for the entire track.

num_samples.description: Total number of audio samples in the track.

duration.description: The total duration of the track in seconds.

sample_md5.description: MD5 hash of the audio sample data.

offset_seconds.description: Offset in seconds from the start of the audio file for analysis.

window_seconds.description: The size of the analysis window in seconds.

analysis_sample_rate.description: The sample rate used for the analysis.

analysis_channels.description: The number of audio channels used for analysis.

end_of_fade_in.description: The time in seconds where the track's fade-in is complete.

start_of_fade_out.description: The time in seconds where the track's fade-out begins.

loudness.description: The overall loudness of the track in LUFS.

tempo.description: The estimated tempo of the track in Beats Per Minute (BPM).

tempo_confidence.description: Confidence score for the tempo estimation (0.0 to 1.0).

time_signature.description: The estimated number of beats per bar.

time_signature_confidence.description: Confidence score for the time signature estimation (0.0 to 1.0).

key.description: The estimated key of the track using Pitch Class notation (0=C, 1=C♯/D♭, ..., 11=B).

key_confidence.description: Confidence score for the key estimation (0.0 to 1.0).

mode.description: The mode of the track (0 for minor, 1 for major).

mode_confidence.description: Confidence score for the mode estimation (0.0 to 1.0).

codestring.description: Proprietary data string for audio fingerprinting.

echoprintstring.description: Proprietary data string for Echo Print fingerprinting.

echoprint_version.description: Version of the Echo Print algorithm.

bars.description: An array of bar markers, indicating the start and duration of each bar.

beats.description: An array of beat markers, indicating the start and duration of each beat.

tatums.description: An array of tatum markers, the smallest time interval between successive notes.

sections.description: An array defining distinct sections of the song (e.g., intro, verse, chorus).

segments.description: An array of audio segments, each with detailed acoustic properties.

start.description: The start time of the segment in seconds.

duration.description: The duration of the segment in seconds.

confidence.description: Confidence score for the segment's boundaries.

loudness_start.description: Loudness at the start of the segment.

loudness_max_time.description: Time offset from the segment start to the point of maximum loudness.

loudness_max.description: The maximum loudness in the segment.

loudness_end.description: Loudness at the end of the segment.

pitches.description: A chroma feature vector representing the 12 pitch classes.

timbre.description: A vector of timbre features (e.g., MFCCs).

timeInterval.description: Represents a time interval with a start, duration, and confidence score.

start.description: The start time of the interval in seconds.

duration.description: The duration of the interval in seconds.

confidence.description: The confidence score for this interval's accuracy (0.0 to 1.0).
